notes: Generated 26 test methods covering 28 confirmed intents across all 4 DDD layers. Domain tests cover all validation scenarios (positive/negative dimensions, valid/invalid types, null/empty types). Application tests verify service orchestration and exception propagation. Infrastructure tests use both in-memory database and mocked DbContext patterns. Presentation tests verify HTTP result types (201 Created, 400 BadRequest, 500 ProblemHttpResult). All tests follow NUnit 3.14.0 with Moq 4.20.72 for mocking. Test naming follows [MethodName]_[Scenario]_[ExpectedResult] convention.
